comment: Calls through to {@link android.os.Trace} methods on supported API levels.

methods.name: public static void beginSection(String sectionName)
methods.comment:
* Writes a trace message to indicate that a given section of code has begun.
   *
   * @see android.os.Trace#beginSection(String)
   * @param sectionName The name of the code section to appear in the trace. This may be at most 127
   *     Unicode code units long.

methods.name: public static void endSection()
methods.comment:
* Writes a trace message to indicate that a given section of code has ended.
   *
   * @see android.os.Trace#endSection()
